scope: Live UI state only; does not attest backend retention
changes: Native header-before-route and route-before-mount return null (unknown), rather than false. Mutation and acceptance guards still require true; read-only receipt polling may wait for the mounted exact Temporary view.

The observed encoded local-chatgpt:{uuid} provisional route stays unknown until its server conversation has a matching mounted Temporary view; it grants no payload, Send, capture or retirement authority.

From 10 November 2026 the mounted view carries its local client ID as conversationId and the server ID only as history.serverConversationId; that field binds the view to the route when scrollStateConversationId is absent.

The predicate returns {state, reason}: state keeps the true, false and null results above, and reason names the check that decided any state other than true. Callers read state alone; refusals report the reason.
